Completion evidence for the documentation-only implementation:

- Gerrit change 2745 merged as `9a4be24ac619e5286ee454dcf131e6de7a4254dc` after `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and zero unresolved comments.
- The landed owned-file tree is byte-identical to independently reviewed author commit `9726a439fb86e3b3bb2cc0ca2ef209794fb5cd9c`; the posted 22-row TSV receipt therefore covers the landed prose exactly.
- Structural checks passed: normalized AST equality, exact bytes outside all 22 allowlisted blocks, unchanged non-allowlisted/inline comments (including the required pragma), and a strict word-count reduction for every edited block.
- Scoped checks passed: 71 focused tests, Ruff check/format, comment hygiene, and path-scoped `git diff --check`; the commit hook also passed repository lint and typecheck.
- Per operator direction, local `make verify` was intentionally not run. Gerrit CI supplied the full contract instead.
